title: Ponker
description: A clean and vanilla  pack focused around smp and pvp gameplay
body:
A CLEAN PACK CENTERED AROUND GOOD LOOKING UTILITY FOR CLEAN AND OPTIMIZED GAMEPLAY EXPERIENCE DESIGNED FOR MAINY SMP AND PVP PLAYERS.
**PACK FEATURES:**
- CUSTOM SKY
- SMALLER ITEMS
- LOW FIRE
- LOW SHIELD
- BETTER SWORDS
- BETTER ARMOR
- CLEAN CRYSTALS
- SELECTIVELY RETEXTURED BLOCKS ETC...


FEATHER CLIENT, SHIED STATUS, NUIT ETC ARE USED FOR THE DISPLAY IMAGES
